definitions.cycle: rising ap_clk edges of the RTL cosimulation at 3.333 ns
definitions.first_output_cycles: first output beat minus first input beat of the first transform (HP-FFT stream interface; not observable for Allo)
definitions.completion_cycles: HP-FFT: last output beat of the first transform minus its first input beat; Allo: ap_start-to-ap_done latency of the first kernel call (Vitis cosim transaction report)
definitions.steady_interval_cycles: mean distance between consecutive transform completions over the last three quarters of the completed transforms (Allo: mean call-to-call interval over the last three quarters of the calls); median/min/max in notes
definitions.transforms_streamed: transforms fed to the design in one cosimulation; transforms_completed = transforms whose outputs appeared
definitions.resources: pnr_ooc rows: Vivado report_utilization after route_design (bram_18k_equiv = 2*RAMB36 + RAMB18); cosim rows carry no resource numbers (HLS estimates are in hls_estimates.csv)
definitions.wns_ns/tns_ns: report_timing_summary after route_design, setup, single clock ap_clk at 3.333 ns, out-of-context (no I/O delays)
definitions.unrouted: report_route_status: routable nets minus fully routed nets
definitions.validation: numpy.allclose(atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4) of the RTL outputs against numpy.fft.fft (complex128) of the exact float32 inputs fed to the RTL; per-seed detail in notes and validation/<run_id>/
definitions.run_by: previous_agent = produced by the earlier agent of this package (its queues/logs), this_agent = produced by the continuation agent (seeded reruns, pnr_worker.sh jobs)
